resources.string: Signing out removes this account, its local message history and encryption keys from this app. Make a backup first if you need to keep them. Your server account remains active. You will need your full account address and password to sign in again.
Sign in with your username or full account address.
Private conversations, on your terms. Create an Operatt account or sign in to an existing one.
Use at least 10 characters for your password.
